title: Queen vs King
summary: Practice shrinking the enemy king's space with the queen.

steps.title: The big idea
steps.body: The queen traps the enemy king by cutting off space. Your king helps finish the job.

steps.title: Start by shrinking the box
steps.body: Do not give random checks forever. First reduce the enemy king's safe area.

steps.title: What should White do first?
steps.question: What is the best practical plan here?

choices.label: Trap the king and bring your king closer

steps.successText: Correct. Restrict first, then bring your king in.
steps.errorText: Not quite. The goal is to shrink the king's space, not just check forever.

steps.title: Make a restricting queen move
steps.body: Move the queen from g2 to g6 to cut off the king without hanging it.
steps.successText: Good. That move cuts the king's space down sharply.
steps.errorText: Try again. Move the queen to g6.

steps.title: After the box shrinks
steps.body: Once the king is boxed in, your king can walk forward and help finish the mate.

steps.title: Lesson recap
steps.body: With queen vs king, shrink the box, bring your king in, and avoid accidental stalemate.
